message:
<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=thought>Let me look at ttcpal.c to see how num_palette_entries is set and whether there's a vulnerability there. The check in tt_face_load_colr_layers validates palette_entry_index against num_palette_entries, but if num_palette_entries is wrong (too large), the check would pass and then later the color index would be used to index into face->palette array which might be smaller.</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
